name: v64_sh_equity_guidance_improvement_no_dispersion
hypothesis: KPbrrxxE is strong but slightly too correlated with LLpZgaeL; removing the analyst-dispersion component may reduce EPSR-style overlap while preserving the shareholder-equity guidance improvement signal.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_maxguidance) / (2 * assets), 63), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_maxguidance) / (2 * assets), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_90_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Direct KPbrrxxE rescue; removes sh-equity estimate dispersion, the likely EPSR-overlap term.

name: v64_sh_equity_guidance_vs_estimate
hypothesis: Guidance above analyst shareholder-equity estimate is more balance-sheet-specific than the raw guidance level and may lower correlation with EPSR estimate signals.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_maxguidance) / 2) / anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_mean, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_maxguidance) / 2) / anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_mean, 63), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_number, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Changes the main signal from level to guidance-vs-estimate delivery; watch divide stability and corr vs LLpZgaeL.

name: v64_qf_sh_equity_guidance_improvement
hypothesis: Quarterly shareholder-equity guidance may retain balance-sheet information but shift timing enough to reduce correlation with annual EPSR-style alphas.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_qf_nd_sh_equity_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_qf_nd_sh_equity_maxguidance) / (2 * assets), 63), 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_qf_nd_sh_equity_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_qf_nd_sh_equity_maxguidance) / (2 * assets), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_qf_nd_sh_equity_maxguidance - anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_qf_nd_sh_equity_minguidance) / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_90_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: Quarterly version of KPbrrxxE; reject if it remains an EPSR/LLpZgaeL near-neighbor.

name: v64_sh_equity_guidance_subindustry
hypothesis: Ranking shareholder-equity guidance improvement within subindustry may reduce broad analyst-expectation co-movement versus LLpZgaeL's industry EPSR signal.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_maxguidance) / (2 * assets), 63), 126), subindustry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_maxguidance) / (2 * assets), 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_high - anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_low) / abs(assets), 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Peer-group axis only; if it stays high-corr, stop sh-equity guidance near-neighbor rescue.

name: v64_sh_equity_guidance_strong_risk_relief

expression: 0.36 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_maxguidance) / (2 * assets), 63), 126), industry) + 0.24 * group_rank(ts_rank((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_maxguidance) / (2 * assets), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_90_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_90_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 90), industry)
notes: Accept lower raw alpha strength in exchange for lower corr; submit only if still passes Sharpe/Fitness.
